{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Native American cuisine|Native American cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Halibut|halibut]] fillet (approximately 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] / 450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]])
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*4 sprigs of fresh [[Cookbook:thyme|thyme]]
*1 [[Cookbook:lemon|lemon]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Fish Stock (Fumet de poisson)|fish stock]]
*1 Tbsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

==Procedure==
#Place the fish in the center of the baking pan.
#Drizzle fish with olive oil and fish stock. Add thyme sprigs, slices of lemon, and sprinkle with pepper. Cover with parchment paper and foil.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] on [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]] at 400 °F  (200 °C) for 15–20 minutes until flesh is flaky.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Cooking in [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]] allows for smells and moisture to be trapped until opened.
* Add vegetables and other cooking liquids to experiment with flavors.
